status_rule: NOTHING on this list is implemented until the owner approves it. Each item gives the decision needed. Approved items get a status change here and a commit.

suggestions.title: Time-stamped official rate log for the chosen dates
suggestions.why: Closes Q-03 and Q-04. The only way to answer 'cheapest time to book' from official sources is a dated record of official rates.
suggestions.how: For each hotel's official booking engine, record: search date/time, check-in/out, rate, resort fee, tax, total. Add one row per search to data/rates_log.json.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve, and pick the dates (Q-01, Q-02).

suggestions.title: Verify room type (queen-or-larger bed, private bathroom) from official room pages
suggestions.why: Closes F05. This is a hard requirement from the brief.
suggestions.how: Open each hotel's room-type pages, record bed type and bathroom statement with URL, and mark each row Verified or Unverified.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve the nine-hotel scope, or name the subset.

suggestions.title: Read cancellation and deposit terms for each shortlisted hotel
suggestions.why: The 'best time to book' depends on flexibility. Caesars' 48-hour cancellation is asterisked (F28).
suggestions.how: Copy the cancellation terms text from each official booking page with its URL.

suggestions.title: Add a Chinatown / Spring Mountain and downtown hotel shortlist
suggestions.why: Six Michelin listings sit on Spring Mountain Rd, but no hotel in the current shortlist is there (Q-06).
suggestions.how: Name candidate hotels from official sites, then run the same checks as S-01 and S-02.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve, or name hotels to add.

suggestions.title: Add RTC trip-planner travel times for each hotel-to-restaurant and hotel-to-activity pair
suggestions.why: The one-hour bus/monorail test is unverified (F20). RTC's trip planner is the official source for transit time.
suggestions.how: Run RTC Trip Planner for each pair, record duration, number of transfers, and the RTC link used. Blank any pair the planner cannot answer.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve; confirm 'bus + monorail' (F01); confirm Red Rock exception (F02).

suggestions.title: Pull official hours, booking windows and menu prices for the remaining 20 listings
suggestions.why: Closes F17, F18, Q-08 and Q-09. Official restaurant sites are reachable, but not every page was retrieved yet.
suggestions.how: Open each official_site link from data/restaurants.json (from LVCVA S03), copy hours and printed prices with the URL. Leave blank where not printed.

suggestions.title: Add activities the owner ranks as interests
suggestions.how: Add entries from official sites (venue, BLM, NPS, state parks, city), with hours, fees and social links.

suggestions.title: Add an events calendar for Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027
suggestions.why: Events affect price and availability (Q-11). Feb 15 is a federal holiday (F13).
suggestions.how: Pull events from official venue and visitor sites. Record the source per event.

suggestions.title: Client-side filters and sorting on every table
suggestions.why: Lets a reader filter by Michelin tier, area or 'verified only' without reloading.
suggestions.how: Add a small script to the generated pages. No external dependencies.

suggestions.title: Add a 'Last verified' date column and a 'Verified' badge per row
suggestions.why: Shows at a glance which values were checked and when.
suggestions.how: Add the date from each row's source retrieval. Show a badge when every value on the row is verified.

suggestions.title: Map view of the Michelin clusters and hotels
suggestions.how: Use free, open map tiles and the addresses already on file. Show only addresses from official sources.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve; confirm no third-party map embed is needed.

suggestions.title: Weighted scorecard for hotels
suggestions.why: Turns price, Michelin count, resort fee, cancellation and transit time into one ranking, using weights the owner sets.
suggestions.how: Add weights in data/scorecard.json. Compute rank in the build script. Show weights on the page.
suggestions.decision_needed: Owner to set weights after Q-03 to Q-07 are answered.

suggestions.title: Add LICENSE, .gitignore and a real README
suggestions.why: Flags F26. The repo has no license, no ignore rules and only a one-line README.
suggestions.how: Add a license chosen by the owner, a standard Python .gitignore, and a README describing the site, data files, and how to rebuild.

suggestions.title: Add a link-check and data-check step in GitHub Actions
suggestions.why: Keeps links and required fields valid on every push, so a broken link cannot reach main unnoticed.
suggestions.how: Add a workflow that runs the build script and fails on a missing source link or a broken internal link.
